newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Vendex enters Dutch convenience sector.
newsitem.headline: Vendex enters Dutch convenience sector.

text.p: Retail and business services group Vendex International NV said on Friday it planned to enter the Dutch convenience food sector, opening one store in December and probably another one in the first quarter of 1997.

The new convenience stores will operate under the name Via and will include a supermarket, a cafeteria and several kinds of services, augmenting the firm's current activities which cover large-scale and discount food retailing. Vendex also operates department stores and temporary employment services.
"The new formula will be additional to Vendex' present food activities," a company spokesman said.

The new formula is to complete the food segments where Vendex currently operates. "The Vendex food group is now present in the discount market with Basismarkt, in the price-attractive market with Edah and in the large scale segment with Konmar," the spokesman added.
If the new formula, which will target city centres and aim at consumers who live, work or shop there, turns out to be a success, Vendex intends to open up to several dozen Via stores.
"We think there is room for several dozen of these stores," the spokesman said. He added that Vendex's nine Dagmarkt stores will be turned into Vias if the formula is a success.
